# Git Workflow

Reference skill for version control practices in the DECDG team.

## Quick Reference

| Convention | Format | Example |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| Commit message | `type(scope): description` | `feat(cleaning): add PPP adjustment` |
| Branch name | `type/short-description` | `feat/poverty-decomposition` |
| PR title | Same as commit convention | `feat(model): add fixed effects specification` |
